- Lifts slow: Library Annex, North Office, Print Room, Garden Studio.

Open Items: Send notes to Esme, Hugo, Kira, Vik, Cora, Dell, Mira, Bram, Wren, Nils. Check with Leon, Kira, Finn, Hugo, Esme, Mira, Ada before respective meetings. Note Finn, Wren, Greta, Mira, Pia, Una, Rafe involvement. Flag inconsistencies. Teo thinks North Office is too cold in the morning.
